rows.en:
{C:8193D601}{C:81958296983300000000}Oh, they're fighting.
Is a war starting?
A war is starting, isn't it?!

{C:81958296993300000000}Come on, let there be waaaar!




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582960D3700000000}That red machine... It's beautiful.

{C:81908400}{C:819582960E3700000000}Does it interest you?

{C:81930100}{C:819582960F3700000000}Oh, Captain Quattro.
Yes, it does.
It's beautiful, like a jewel.

{C:81909E00}{C:81958296103700000000}Without someone to pilot it,
it's nothing but scrap metal.
Isn't that right, Char?

{C:81908400}{C:81958296113700000000}Haman.
How many times must I tell you? I'm...

{C:81909E00}{C:81958296123700000000}Hah! How long will you keep up this charade?
Don't you understand yet?!
What we need now is power.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296133700000000}Are you saying...
I don't have that power?


{C:81909E00}{C:81958296143700000000}What power could you have,
now that you're a spineless Federation puppet?

{C:81958296153700000000}A man without ambition has no power!
Be Char again!
Even if it's only for this battle.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296163700000000}Haman...

{C:81909E00}{C:81958296173700000000}That's all I have to say.


{C:81908400}{C:81958296183700000000}Only for this battle...?
So Haman also feels
that the enemy's power is that great.

{C:81958296193700000000}Very well, Haman.
For now, I'll go along with your proposal.
Until we've defeated the enemy before us.

{C:81930100}{C:819582961A3700000000}Captain Quattro?

{C:81908400}{C:819582961B3700000000}From now on, I will be Char again,
for the sake of this battle.

{C:81930100}{C:819582961C3700000000}Char?


{C:81908400}{C:819582961D3700000000}Yes.
The man feared as the Red Comet:
Char Aznable.

{C:819582961E3700000000}I'm going to service my MS.
Give me a hand.

{C:81930100}{C:819582961F3700000000}Oh, yes. Of course.





{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81907B02}{C:81958296EC3100000000}You're all safe!

{C:81907D02}{C:81958296ED3100000000}I was worried about yooou!

{C:81907E02}{C:819582964D0100000000}Weren't you and the others in trouble
without us, Jin?

{C:81907C02}{C:81958296EE3100000000}Us?
Of course not.
Right, Jin?

{C:81909202}{C:81958296EF3100000000}You liaaar!
Weren't you saying, 'If only we could pull off an invincible combination into Raijin-Oh,'
or something like that?

{C:81908302}{C:81958296F03100000000}Oh? Who are these people?

{C:81909602}{C:81958296F13100000000}We're Gambaruger's pilots,
the Ganba Team!

{C:81909402}{C:81958296F23100000000}Rikiya, is that all right?
Giving away our identities so easily?

{C:81909202}{C:81958296F33100000000}It's fine.
The curse doesn't work here, after all.

{C:81909D02}{C:81958296F43100000000}That's riiight!

{C:81909402}{C:81958296F53100000000}Waaah! It's Yaminorius!

{C:81909202}{C:81958296F63100000000}You bastard! What the hell are you doing here?!

{C:81908E02}{C:81958296F73100000000}Calm down, boy.

{C:81907B02}{C:81958296F93100000000}{C:819782830400}Belzeb{C:819782830000}!
Even you've come here?!

{C:81908F02}{C:81958296FA3100000000}Didn't I tell you to calm down?

{C:81907E02}{C:819582964E0100000000}Then what are you here for?
Explain yourselves!

{C:81909D02}{C:81958296FB3100000000}This place is filled with an evil power
unlike our own.

{C:81908E02}{C:81958296FC3100000000}Because of that,
our power is all but nonexistent.

{C:81908F02}{C:81958296FD3100000000}That's what we came to tell you.

{C:81908E02}{C:81958296FE3100000000}For now,
we won't lay a hand on you.

{C:81909602}{C:81958296013200000000}Is that really true?
I'm not sure I can believe it.

{C:81908D02}{C:81958296023200000000}My power is restricted as well.

{C:81907B02}{C:81958296033200000000}{C:819782830400}Eldran{C:819782830000}!
It's been ages!

{C:81908D02}{C:81958296043200000000}I have no intention of speaking for evil,
but it is the truth.

{C:81907E02}{C:819582964F0100000000}If even Eldran says so,
I suppose we can believe you.

{C:81908E02}{C:81958296053200000000}We won't be crossing paths
with you anyway.
Do as you please.

{C:81909D02}{C:81958296063200000000}Then I'll disappear as well.
Hazuramu Saraiyaa!

{C:81908F02}{C:81958296073200000000}Well then, do your best!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296083200000000}Um... What was all that about?

{C:81907D02}{C:81958296093200000000}Belzeb and Falzeb
are our enemies.

{C:81909202}{C:819582960A3200000000}Yaminorius
is our enemy.

{C:81907B02}{C:819582960B3200000000}Eldran is the one who gave us
Raijin-Oh... I guess?

{C:81909402}{C:819582960C3200000000}Eldran gave us
Gambaruger.

{C:81930100}{C:819582960D3200000000}Ha ha... I see.
Oh, right.

{C:819582960E3200000000}(The world's a big place... isn't it?)




{x00}

{C:81908202}{C:81958296C13900000000}Surely no one will find me
here, right?

{C:81908A02}{C:81958296C23900000000}Hidenori,
what are you sneaking around for?

{C:81908202}{C:81958296C33900000000}Waaah!
...Oh, I was mistaken.

{C:81908A02}{C:81958296C43900000000}What on earth is wrong?

{C:81908202}{C:81958296C53900000000}I-I
haven't been here!


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81908A02}{C:81958296C63900000000}What's he so flustered about...?

{C:81908902}{C:81958296C83900000000}Tokieee!
Have you seen Hidenori?

{C:81908A02}{C:81958296CB3900000000}...You've been doing special training, haven't you?

{C:81908902}{C:81958296CC3900000000}Yes, that's right.
How did you know?

{C:81908A02}{C:81958296CD3900000000}Special training is your specialty, Love.
Of course I knew!

{C:81908902}{C:81958296CF3900000000}So, do you know
where Hidenori went?

{C:81908A02}{C:81958296D03900000000}He went that way, but...

{C:81908902}{C:81958296D13900000000}That way!
Thanks, Tokie!

{C:81908A02}{C:81958296D23900000000}(Poor Hidenori.)




{x00}

{C:8190A702}{C:819582960F3200000000}Hey, lady! Hey, lady!

{C:8190CD02}{C:81958296103200000000}Hey, Faye-Faye!
She's calling you!

{C:8190CC02}{C:81958296123200000000}Oh, even a little squirt like you
is on that ship?
So, what do you want?


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8190A702}{C:81958296133200000000}Lady, you've got huge boobs!

{C:8190CC02}{C:81958296143200000000}Huh?

{C:8190CD02}{C:81958296153200000000}Faaaye, are your boobs huge?

{C:8190A702}{C:81958296163200000000}Cow boobs! Cow booobs!
Nya ha ha ha ha ha!

{C:8190CD02}{C:81958296173200000000}Faye's boobs are cow booobs!
...What are cow boobs?

{C:8190CC02}{C:81958296183200000000}Oh, for crying out loud!
I can't deal with you two!





{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81901C00}{C:81958296FF3300000000}I'm envious of you, Fyana and Noin.
The men you're with
are so straightforward.

{C:8190C900}{C:81958296003400000000}Chirico isn't straightforward.
If anything, he's quiet.

{C:8190EB01}{C:819582966B0100000000}Zechs will suddenly
leave me behind, you know.
Would you still want that?

{C:81901C00}{C:81958296013400000000}Hehe. I heard from
some other girls earlier,
and everyone seems to have their troubles.

{C:8190C900}{C:81958296023400000000}Nothing comes easily,
just like this battle.

{C:8190EB01}{C:819582966C0100000000}I think there's nothing wrong
with doing our best
for our own happiness.

{C:81901C00}{C:81958296043400000000}You're right.




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8193EB01}{C:81958296710100000000}Zechs, where are you?
Oh, have you seen Zechs?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296133400000000}I haven't seen him.

{C:8193CC02}{C:81958296143400000000}Do you enjoy clinging
to that Zechs fellow,
even though he leaves you behind?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296153400000000}(Ugh, what an unpleasant atmosphere.)

{C:8193EB01}{C:81958296720100000000}I do.
Whatever our difference in rank,
Zechs and I are equals at heart.

{C:8193CC02}{C:81958296173400000000}Hmm, equals, are you?
That's one way of looking at it.
How interesting.

{C:819582961A3400000000}I'll observe you for a while.
Heh, you don't mind, do you?

{C:8193EB01}{C:81958296730100000000}Please yourself.




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8193A102}{C:81958296D03300000000}What's wrong, Relena?
You're staring into space.
That's not like you.

{C:8193D301}{C:81958296D13300000000}Don't you think it's hard
to understand how boys feel?

{C:8193A102}{C:81958296D23300000000}Oh, I agree.
They're a different species,
so maybe it can't be helped.

{C:81958296D33300000000}But I'm sure the boys
think they can't understand
girls either.

{C:8193D301}{C:81958296D43300000000}So the feeling's mutual?

{C:8193A102}{C:81958296D53300000000}Exactly.
So don't worry so much
about Heero.

{C:8193D301}{C:81958296D63300000000}You can tell?

{C:8193A102}{C:81958296D73300000000}Of course.
You're so sweet, Relena.

{C:8193D301}{C:81958296D83300000000}Hime!




{x00}

{C:81904501}{C:819582969F3700000000}We've been waiting for you.
We in the Security Unit have learned the truth.
We're siding with Lord Le Caine.

{C:81958296A03700000000}From now on,
we'll be serving under you.





{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81905E02}{C:81958296B73700000000}Hey, kid.
Do you know someone called Roger?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B83700000000}Mr. Roger,
someone's asking for you.

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296BA3700000000}Colonel Gon Jem?
What on earth do you want?!
Our negotiations broke down.

{C:81905E02}{C:81958296BB3700000000}Things have changed.
Staying alive comes
before money.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296BC3700000000}Staying alive... you say?

{C:81905F02}{C:81958296BD3700000000}If we let that Binzvanker
have free rein,
the world'll come to an end.

{C:81958296BE3700000000}We've changed our minds.

{C:81906102}{C:81958296BF3700000000}Hya hya hya hya!
That's the way it is.

{C:81906002}{C:81958296C03700000000}I'll be in trouble if the world goes away.

{C:8190A202}{C:81958296C23700000000}That's commendable.
But you won't be paid. Understood?

{C:81905E02}{C:81958296C33700000000}If you'll give us weapons and ammo,
we'll forget about the money.
Anything to stay alive!




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81908302}{C:81958296A83900000000}My, my, myyy! It's lovely here.
To think there could be such a difference...
It's very interesting!

{C:81908C02}{C:81958296A93900000000}It looks like there'll be
plenty of delicious food here, too!

{C:81908B02}{C:81958296AA3900000000}I'd rather meet
the Security Unit than eat.

{C:81908102}{C:81958296AB3900000000}The Security Unit?!
That's far too dangerous, Kirara!

{C:81908B02}{C:81958296AC3900000000}No way! We've come all this way.
I've got to get an on-the-spot report.
Oh, there they are! I'll be off!

{C:81908102}{C:81958296AD3900000000}I said no!
...Oh, she's gone.

{C:81908C02}{C:81958296AE3900000000}Then I'll go
and look for somewhere to eat.

{C:81908302}{C:81958296AF3900000000}Ohhh, everyone!
You can't just do whatever you want!




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81908402}{C:81958296B03900000000}Look, everyone! That's
{C:819782830300}Grados{C:819782830000} headquarters!

{C:81958296B13900000000}Wouldn't it be awesome
to hold a concert there?
Ooh, I'm fired up!

{C:81908602}{C:81958296B23900000000}...Yeah.

{C:81908502}{C:81958296B33900000000}What's wrong, Yoppa?
You don't look too happy.
Are you hungry or something?

{C:81908602}{C:81958296B43900000000}That too,
but there's no TV here.
It's boring.

{C:81908502}{C:81958296B53900000000}Oh, dear, dear, dear...
Then let's go back to the ship
and ask to watch something.

{C:81908602}{C:81958296B63900000000}I guess that's all we can do...

{C:81908402}{C:81958296B73900000000}Oh, you're going back to the ship?
I'll come too.



{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81907F02}{C:81958296B83900000000}Hey, hey, Hiroshi!

{C:81908102}{C:81958296BA3900000000}Cookie,
what are you all doing here?

{C:81908702}{C:81958296BB3900000000}Have you seen Asuka?
We were going to look around
Grados together.

{C:81908802}{C:81958296BC3900000000}We can't find him anywhere.
We thought
maybe you might know.

{C:81908102}{C:81958296BD3900000000}Everyone went off on their own
once we left the ship.
Sorry, I don't know.

{C:81908802}{C:81958296BE3900000000}If you don't know, you don't know.
What should we do, everyone?

{C:81908002}{C:81958296EB3A00000000}Um...

{C:81908702}{C:81958296BF3900000000}Oh, it's you, Yu.
Is something wrong?

{C:81908002}{C:81958296EC3A00000000}If you're looking for Asuka,
I think he went that way...

{C:81907F02}{C:81958296C03900000000}Thank you, Yu!
Come on, everyone.

{C:81908002}{C:81958296ED3A00000000}I-I'll come along too.



{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81906101}{C:81958296483700000000}I've been waiting, brave heroes!

{C:81900300}{C:819582964A3700000000}C-Chief Taiga?!

{C:81930100}{C:819582964B3700000000}What are you doing
on this continent, Chief?!

{C:81906101}{C:819582964C3700000000}Never mind that!
Her Majesty Queen Ciela
is waiting for you.

{C:81900400}{C:819582964D3700000000}Lady Ciela?

{C:81902000}{C:819582964E3700000000}Everyone,
I'm glad you've returned.

{C:819582964F3700000000}I've decided to board
Astante II as well.
That is all right, isn't it?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296503700000000}Even if you ask
whether it's all right...

{C:81902000}{C:81958296513700000000}Is there a problem?
Then tell me.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296523700000000}There's no problem with the ship,
but what about Na?

{C:81902000}{C:81958296533700000000}It seems Drake has also
left this land.
And so I shall go as well.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296543700000000}I understand.
We'll cooperate.

{C:81902000}{C:81958296553700000000}I am counting on you.





{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81902400}{C:81958296563700000000}I've been
waiting for you.

{C:81958296573700000000}The ship has arrived.
Have them hurry with loading the supplies.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296583700000000}Thank you, Lady Elle.

{C:81902400}{C:81958296593700000000}Not at all. It's the least I can do.

{C:819582965A3700000000}More importantly, I have a request.
Will you hear me out?

{C:81930100}{C:819582965B3700000000}If it's something we can do.

{C:81902400}{C:819582965C3700000000}Please let me join the battle.
I've learned to pilot an Aura Battler.
You'll take me with you, won't you?

{C:81900300}{C:819582965D3700000000}What should we do, big brother?

{C:81900400}{C:819582965E3700000000}She seems determined.
She's even learned to pilot one.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296603700000000}True...

{C:81958296623700000000}Very well, Lady Elle.
Please come with us.

{C:81902400}{C:81958296633700000000}Then it's settled?
Thank you!





{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81902A00}{C:81958296643700000000}You're the crew of the ship
fighting Lord Drake, aren't you?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296653700000000}You're from that time...
Are you going to arrest us?

{C:81902A00}{C:81958296663700000000}...No.
Lord Drake has abandoned me.
I've been hiding here all this time.

{C:81958296683700000000}Please!
Take me away from this continent.
I'll do anything if you take me with you.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296693700000000}We're fighting
Drake too, you know.
Are you sure you don't mind?

{C:81902A00}{C:819582966A3700000000}Staying here would only put me in danger.
I accept that I have no choice.

{C:81900300}{C:819582966B3700000000}You won't have to fight if you don't want to.
We don't mind.
Come with us.

{C:81902A00}{C:819582966C3700000000}I'm sorry to impose. I'm in your debt.





{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81903300}{C:819582966D3700000000}Lord Nie!!

{C:81901E00}{C:819582966F3700000000}Riml!
What are you doing here?!

{C:81903300}{C:81958296703700000000}Gyre Garing was about to leave,
so I hurried and hid.

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296723700000000}How reckless...
But I'm glad you're safe.
Rie, may we take Riml aboard?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296733700000000}Of course.
Welcome, Riml.

{C:81903300}{C:81958296743700000000}I'm counting on you from now on.





{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81906600}{C:81958296803700000000}Heh heh heh heh heh...

{C:81900300}{C:81958296813700000000}Big brotheeer, there's someone strange
looking over here!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296823700000000}Ignoring them is the best thing to do.

{C:81906500}{C:81958296833700000000}Ignoring us...?
That's cold, boy!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296843700000000}You're... from Posaydal's army...

{C:81906500}{C:81958296863700000000}That's right! I'm one of the Thirteen:
Lili Hassy!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296873700000000}What do the Thirteen want with us?
If you want a fight, I'll take you on!

{C:81906600}{C:81958296883700000000}How spirited.
Fu ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha...

{C:81906500}{C:81958296893700000000}Shut up, little girl!
We've come to help you
with your battles!

{C:81930100}{C:819582968A3700000000}The Thirteen? Some of the very best
in Posaydal's army?
That's rather hard to believe.

{C:81906300}{C:819582968B3700000000}The Thirteen aren't
all of one mind.

{C:81906500}{C:819582968C3700000000}We're coming with you,
even if you don't want us to.

{C:81930100}{C:819582968D3700000000}(Hey, now...)






{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900A02}{C:81958296AF3700000000}Hey, kid. Hey, kid!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B03700000000}Huh, me?

{C:81900A02}{C:81958296B13700000000}Yeah, you.
Could you let me
aboard your ship?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B23700000000}Who are you?

{C:81900A02}{C:81958296B33700000000}{C:819782830400}Timp Sharon{C:819782830000}

{C:81900400}{C:81958296B43700000000}Timp is Jiron and the others' enemy.
Are you sure we can let him aboard?

{C:81900A02}{C:81958296B53700000000}We've got the same goal now.
I'm sure they'll understand.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B63700000000}To be honest, we could use the firepower.
I'll try to persuade them.





{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81902D00}{C:819582968F3A00000000}I've been watching your battles...
The odds are bad for me.
I don't make reckless bets.

{C:81958296903A00000000}I'm joining you.

{C:81900600}{C:81958296913A00000000}If you can follow our orders,
I'll allow you aboard.
Well?

{C:81902D00}{C:81958296923A00000000}If I said no...
you wouldn't let me aboard, would you?
I have no choice but to obey.

{C:81958296933A00000000}{C:819782830400}Allen Brady{C:819782830000} is my name.
I'm counting on you.

{C:81900600}{C:81958296943A00000000}Welcome to Astante II.
We're glad to have you.




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8193CB02}{C:81958296EF3300000000}Whew. Having to go outside the ship
just to smoke a cigarette...
It's a real pain.

{C:8193BA01}{C:81958296F03300000000}Then don't smoke.

{C:8193CB02}{C:81958296F13300000000}I can't do without cigarettes.

{C:8193BA01}{C:81958296F23300000000}Then there's nothing you can do.

{C:8193CB02}{C:81958296F33300000000}Well, true enough.

{C:81958296F43300000000}But tell me,
do you enjoy living like that?

{C:8193BA01}{C:81958296F53300000000}I have no obligation to answer.

{C:8193CB02}{C:81958296F63300000000}Well, that's true enough.




{x00}

{C:81930100}{C:819582966B3300000000}Let's see, where's Rie...?
Oh, she's talking to Henken and the others.
I'll wait till later.


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81931E00}{C:819582966D3300000000}I always try to stay calm,
but I get worked up so easily.

{C:81938900}{C:819582966E3300000000}I can only do things my own way, too.
I've acted on my own
and failed before.

{C:81930300}{C:819582966F3300000000}But you both served admirably
as captains, didn't you?
That's amazing!

{C:81931E00}{C:81958296713300000000}What are you saying?
You're the captain now, Rie.

{C:81938900}{C:81958296723300000000}We're merely guests
aboard Astante II.

{C:81958296733300000000}If I may give my opinion,
I think you're doing
quite well as captain.

{C:81931E00}{C:81958296743300000000}Yes, to be honest,
I think so too.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296753300000000}Thank you.
It makes me very happy
to hear that from you both.



{x00}
